Dockworker Amphol appears towards the end of Act Three in the Lower City.
“
Torm help me! A mind flayer!
„
— Amphol, on her fellow citizens suddenly transforming into Mind Flayers

Involvement

Act Three

Dockworker Amphol appears just south of the Basilisk Gate in the Lower City once the party have collected all three Netherstones. If the party approaches, people on the square are forcefully transformed into a Mind Flayers. Amphol usually is killed by a transformed  Deeziks Tormo.
